request_allocation.unknown_effect_retries: No automatic retries; preserve lease until explicit reconciliation.

sizing_basis: S02 NORMALIZE adds one exact raw occurrence row plus primary, unit and business-key indexes for each returned record.

S02 DERIVE adds at most one source_observation plus primary/company/security indexes and one expected_observation plus primary key per distinct raw version; duplicates reduce this upper row-count scenario.

Actual source records sampled in s02_128page_readback.json contain only the five documented short-interest fields and approximately118KB per1000-record page, but canonical lineage and repeated hash keys expand storage materially.
8–12KiB per returned record is a conservative planning range for raw occurrence, generic canonical/expected rows, indexes, alignment and allocation; it is NOT a measured PostgreSQL row-size bound.
D02 planning uses actual Aug3 count12402 per day,512bytes per compact row including index allowance, and uncompressed raw-source bytes. Date-to-date record counts can differ.
The4GB mission relation ceiling, per-response8MiB limit, single active task and pre/postbatch guards remain the binding resource envelope; forecasts do not authorize expansion beyond it.

budget.basis: No new request ceiling is needed. Existing prepaid source entitlement and fixed compute remain unchanged. Raising a logical SQL relation guard does not provision disk capacity.

disk_qualification.freshness_limit: This earlier shared-project probe is not a current whole-project usage guarantee; WAL and other workloads are outside the mission relation sum.
disk_qualification.first_step_conservative_contingency: Existing $50 storage contingency exceeds one full 200GB autoexpand month at official $0.195/GB-month io2 ($39) or gp3 $0.125 ($25); this is contingency, not an observed invoice, actual disk type, or authorization to buy/retain new capacity.
disk_qualification.no_recurring_cost_guarantee: A disk expansion caused by unrelated usage or WAL can recur and continue billing after mission closure. Mission controls do not establish a permanent account-wide cap; root must retain the existing storage-expansion review/closure gate.

admission_conditions: Root locks current owner/fence/scope/stop and counters before changing page cap or logical relation allowance.
Keep raw250MB, one active task,8MiB per response, provider6039/HTTP6055 ceilings and existing deadline.
Keep unknown-effect provider leases and original checkpoints intact; page144 is a review boundary if still nonterminal.
Measure ordinary first committed S02 NORMALIZE and DERIVE batches by relation-size delta/timing; use those existing-work receipts to forecast remaining growth, without a separate capacity probe.
Postbatch guard may leave physical allocation from a rolled-back batch; stop after the first resource failure rather than repeatedly retrying.
Keep company/security mapping unresolved and publication scheduled-date versus actual-time distinctions; terminal source page is not certified company completeness.
